t: This is Your Party, a socialist political party in the United Kingdom. It was announced in July 2025 by Jeremy Corbyn and Zarah Sultana, and registered with the Electoral Commission on 30 September 2025. Corbyn, MP for Islington North since 1983, led the Labour Party from 2015 to 2020. Sultana, MP for Coventry South since 2019, became the party's first MP in the Commons in November 2025. The party is run by a Central Executive Committee under collective leadership, and Corbyn has been its parliamentary leader since March 2026.
